title: [VIC] U98 Fuel $2.339/L @ 7-Eleven Bayswater East
body:
Deal: [VIC] U98 Fuel $2.339/L @ 7-Eleven Bayswater East

[sprof] 7/11 shot down multiple of my choppers RIP
[dlovep] Within state is fine, other states not working.
[sprof] Yes that was working for awhile but nuked accounts as with quite a few other people I know
[SBOB] My chopper seems to broken, with an a01 error
Might have to try a new chopper
[SeaveyA1] Choppers are restricted to flying within the local state, A01 is when you go out of bounds
[SBOB] My chopper throwning up a01 in same state…sometimes even when I just need to make a short flight a few ks away
[safrane] @SBOB: Stuff like VPNs, or even plugged into USB will trigger this error.
[TheDukeOfNukem] Went out for a little ride on the motorbike earlier today, nice weather.
Went past a servo, $2.2x
"Nah, (profanity) that, I'll fill up at home, surely less"
Cheapest back home: $2.4x
"Ah, (profanity)"
[Palta] Use petrolspy to check what the price is at home, or what good prices are around at any destination you are travelling to, and then lock the price. Has saved me a couple of times
[LemonJuice87] just locked in 233.9, i'm in range as well.
[ScoMosas] Can you log in into my account and lock it for me? TIA
[AdamFury] I remember when fuel prices used to start with a 1. Simpler times.
[Lizard Spock] Don't change the subject, we're talking about simpler times.
[Skinnerr] 'Memba wen my nanna used to buy 2 standard quarts for a thruppance!
[Lizard Spock] She had an onion tied to her belt, which was the style at the time.
[Upolo] I note this on the Fuel Lock promo on the app homepage. Has me thinking that they might be axing it?

Offer expires 11:59pm 29th September 2026

Also both major parties budgets are within a couple of percent.
[boozed] You go ahead and we'll be right behind you
[Fuzor] There should be more punishment for EV buyers. Its just BS that all dinojuice ICE car owners have to pay this stupid federal government's fuel excise when EV drivers get to pay nothing. Instead of a luxury car tax, there should just be a sustainable car tax covering all EV and hybrids. If older ICE drivers suffer, they should should be made to suffer as well.
And stupid Labor still wont buy Russian oil when even the Republicans in the US are proposing to do business with Russia again. Cannot wait until federal Labor get kicked out for good
[boomramada] Wasn't a few Russian refineries got hit by the Ukrainians as well?
[Mike444] Locked in $2.08 for U98 only 10 days ago. It's rising quickly.
[SeaveyA1] Per FuelCheck, something like 4-5c per day for the past week or so. Starting to peak but not sure to be honest.
[BestTechAdvisor] I saw Diesel @ $3.00/L today. Fuggg Donnie Trump.
[Skinnerr] Yemen has entered the war, bombed a Saudi oil pipeline and an oil tanker in transit in the Red Sea (the long way around the SOH) after pleading for US intervention/help after seeing the Yemeni's mobilse against Saudi Arabia. But the US Navy is partying in Thailand haha! 😂

After what they did to thier franchisees, I'm not going near them.
[Upolo] Find me a corporate that has never screwed over its franchisees.

[Lord Ra] NOT* company owned you mean?
Yes, it's like to see how the courts deal with this.
